fields.subject: ArgentSea.Orleans.Pg ArgentSeaOrleansMembershipTable reads
fields.trigger: the read query runs in one REPEATABLE READ transaction
fields.response: ReadAll maps three result sets (the version row; every member row with its own etag; the suspect rows, each attached to its member, an unknown member's row logged and skipped) and ReadRow maps two (the addressed member row joined to the version row; its suspect rows); a missing version row (ReadAll) or member row (ReadRow) throws OrleansException; a member version ahead of the table version is logged as an error
fields.postcondition: all result sets of a read come from one snapshot, and every DateTime returned has Kind Utc
